structure_source: Reddi 2023 JACS 10.1021/jacs.2c08853, Figure 5A (compounds 4b-4g); transcribed from the figure and cross-checked against the panel-B adduct mass shift
notes: RESOLVED. Tunable: the N-substituent R sets reactivity across roughly an order of magnitude (k ~0.005-0.068 M-1 s-1). Designed as a lower-reactivity replacement for chloroacetamide with better buffer stability.
Compound 4a. Included for completeness of the Reddi series; note it labels Pin1 POORLY (~17%) despite high intrinsic k, so it is an anchor for the reactivity axis but NOT an example of a good binder.
